blurb: Guests can enjoy wine tastings in a tasting room overlooking Okanagan Lake, participate in vineyard strolls and educational tours, and book private winery events including rooftop patio receptions and fine dining in the Summit Room. The winery produces wines from several vineyards in the Okanagan and Similkameen Valleys, emphasizing terroir and quality.
